artwork: Threshold white screenshot lettering at 170; trace eight connected shapes and holes with OpenCV at 0.65px contour tolerance; convert deep bevelled extrusions into eight meshes with graphite faces, dark sidewalls and brighter bevels. Oblique orthographic camera exposes depth. Screenshot background discarded.

delivery.color: RGB555-style quantization; binary alpha; nearest-neighbour display
delivery.playback: Once per selection, indefinite final hold; final frame immediately for reduced motion
delivery.motion: Pixel chevron writes HACK left-to-right, turns downward, writes LDN right-to-left, rotates into its final position. No cube.
delivery.caption: 2025 at completion, using existing portfolio text renderer
